# PathMakers Technologies

> PathMakers Technologies is a custom software development company based in Tamil Nadu, India. We build tailored web applications, mobile apps, business automation systems, and ready-to-use software products including Vidhai ERP.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://pathmakerstech.in/solutions/custom-software): Tailored software architecture designed around unique business workflows.
- [Web Applications](https://pathmakerstech.in/solutions/web-applications): Modern, scalable web applications built with React, Node, and cloud infrastructure.
- [Mobile Apps](https://pathmakerstech.in/solutions/mobile-apps): Native and cross-platform iOS & Android mobile applications.
- [Business Automation](https://pathmakerstech.in/solutions/business-automation): Workflow automation, API integrations, and digital transformation for operational efficiency.
- [Vidhai ERP - School Management System](https://pathmakerstech.in/products/vidhai-erp): Comprehensive ERP software for educational institutions handling admissions, attendance, fees, exams, and communication.
